This log persists across runs and is never archived with the work-id. Adjudicate each lesson before banking it — the playbook holds open problems you are carrying forward, not a log of everything learned. If a lesson is understood and fixable now, APPLY it this run (make the bounded edit, record it in AGENT_FEEDBACK) and do not add a playbook entry at all; a lesson goes in the bank (an add) ONLY because it needs to be re-observed to be understood, and every add must carry a bank_reason saying what re-observation will clarify. Applying to project doctrine (a docs/agents/* delta or a template working copy — any .md / .template.*) is a human call: it needs authority=human on the apply op, and in delegated/autonomous mode you do NOT self-apply doctrine — surface it to your principal (who may rule 'apply', or 'wait, observe it again') and defer with 'needs human' until they do.
